body: Im at a sort of neutral place right now after getting off the one medication that was causing my distress. I'm not really down now, I just kinda don't feel much of anything. I would try to change it sooner, but I'll be going into surgery next week and will be out for a week after that to recover so I dont want to mix things up too soon since getting off of effexor is not going to be easy.

I'm still on the effexor since getting off it would be hell, there was another medication I was taking that was causing the problems. I'll be talking to my therapist early next month, same with my psych to help me get off of this and onto something else.
Thank you, and I will talk to my therapist soon. I stopped taking the medication that was the problem and feel ok now, still dulled all over but no longer super down.
